_comment: CI integrity ratchet baseline (OSE-1606). Counts may only fall; every entry carries a reason.

.github/workflows/advanced-security-scan.reason: Advisory scanner steps (upload / optional scans); findings are reported elsewhere, not a merge gate.

.github/workflows/claude-review.yml.reason: AI review is advisory by design (claude-review-switch); a review outage must not block merges.

.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml.reason: Advisory dependency-review annotation; audit gates are the blocking path.

.github/workflows/mobile-workability-aud.reason: Nightly deployed-staging audit is advisory; the PR-code mobile audit in oursharedevents-ci.yml blocks.

.github/workflows/oursharedevents-ci.yml.reason: Root-only hub staging steps (best-effort, @ocr/ui not imported, OSE-341) and dorny/test-reporter check publishers; reporters never gate, the test step does.

.github/workflows/red-team-adversarial.y.reason: Report-publishing step; the red-team run itself decides the result.

.github/workflows/security-regression.ym.reason: Advisory reporting step; regression assertions run in blocking steps.

.github/workflows/security-scan.yml.reason: Scanner upload/annotation steps; the scan verdict gates elsewhere.
